name: docs-standards
description: Documentation conventions for a repo's docs/ tree, adopted by a repository rather than enabled for an account. Covers the Diátaxis split across decisions, plans, runbooks and reference, Nygard ADRs and their template, the ephemeral-plan lifecycle, README-index and staleness discipline, and the agent and verify callouts. Ships a Stop hook that runs a doc-maintenance checklist at session end. Depends on markdown-standards for the Markdown itself and on writing-styles for the instructional-writing style a reference doc follows.
